build_fuse_gtest_files: build a python script to fuse Google Test source code into a single gtest.h and gtest-all.cc file
create_fused_gtest_installation: create a fused Google Test installation by running fuse_gtest_files.py with an output directory argument
run_fuse_gtest_with_custom_root: run fuse_gtest_files.py with a custom GTEST_ROOT_DIR and OUTPUT_DIR to generate fused gtest files
review_fuse_gtest_h_function: review the FuseGTestH function that scans gtest_root to generate gtest/gtest.h in output_dir
review_fuse_gtest_all_cc_function: review the FuseGTestAllCc function that scans gtest_root to generate gtest/gtest-all.cc in output_dir
